question: What trials are studying pembrolizumab for Erdheim-Chester disease?

input.sql:
SELECT p.asset_id, a.canonical_name, p.max_phase_active, p.max_phase_ever, p.n_trials, p.n_active_trials, p.nct_ids
FROM v_programs p JOIN assets a USING (asset_id)
WHERE p.condition_key = 'D031249' AND p.asset_id = 'pembrolizumab'

SELECT ta.nct_id, ta.role, v.brief_title, v.overall_status, v.phase_norm, v.is_industry, v.lead_company_id
FROM trial_assets ta
JOIN trial_conditions_norm tc ON tc.nct_id = ta.nct_id
JOIN v_trials v ON v.nct_id = ta.nct_id
WHERE ta.asset_id = 'pembrolizumab' AND tc.condition_key = 'D031249'
SELECT nct_id, condition_key, display_name FROM trial_conditions_norm WHERE condition_key = 'D031249'

SELECT ta.nct_id, ta.role, v.brief_title, v.overall_status, v.phase_norm
FROM trial_assets ta JOIN v_trials v ON v.nct_id = ta.nct_id
WHERE ta.asset_id='pembrolizumab'

SELECT ta.nct_id, ta.role, v.brief_title, v.overall_status, v.phase_norm
FROM trial_assets ta
JOIN v_trials v ON v.nct_id = ta.nct_id
WHERE ta.asset_id='pembrolizumab' AND ta.nct_id IN (
'NCT01727206','NCT03329274','NCT06332183','NCT07440290','NCT04198818','NCT05768178','NCT01417520','NCT06317246',
'NCT04079179','NCT05915208','NCT02523040','NCT05092815','NCT06712810','NCT02298634','NCT03990428','NCT07454343',
'NCT02285582','NCT05093335','NCT01552434','NCT02089724','NCT02608619','NCT03794297')

SELECT DISTINCT ta.asset_id, a.canonical_name, ta.role, ta.nct_id
FROM trial_assets ta JOIN assets a ON a.asset_id = ta.asset_id
WHERE ta.nct_id IN (
'NCT01727206','NCT03329274','NCT06332183','NCT07440290','NCT04198818','NCT05768178','NCT01417520','NCT06317246',
'NCT04079179','NCT05915208','NCT02523040','NCT05092815','NCT06712810','NCT02298634','NCT03990428','NCT07454343',
'NCT02285582','NCT05093335','NCT01552434','NCT02089724','NCT02608619','NCT03794297')
AND (a.canonical_name ILIKE '%pembro%' OR ta.asset_id ILIKE '%pembro%' OR ta.asset_id ILIKE '%keytruda%')

SELECT ta.nct_id, ta.asset_id, a.canonical_name, ta.role, v.brief_title, v.overall_status, v.phase_norm
FROM trial_assets ta JOIN assets a ON a.asset_id=ta.asset_id JOIN v_trials v ON v.nct_id=ta.nct_id
WHERE ta.nct_id IN (
'NCT01727206','NCT03329274','NCT06332183','NCT07440290','NCT04198818','NCT05768178','NCT01417520','NCT06317246',
'NCT04079179','NCT05915208','NCT02523040','NCT05092815','NCT06712810','NCT02298634','NCT03990428','NCT07454343',
'NCT02285582','NCT05093335','NCT01552434','NCT02089724','NCT02608619','NCT03794297')

SELECT nct_id, intervention_no, asset_id, via, role, in_all_arms FROM trial_assets
WHERE nct_id IN ('NCT02089724','NCT02608619','NCT02298634','NCT03990428','NCT07454343','NCT02285582','NCT01417520')

SELECT nct_id, brief_title, overall_status, phase_norm FROM v_trials
WHERE nct_id IN ('NCT02089724','NCT02608619','NCT02298634','NCT03990428','NCT07454343','NCT02285582','NCT01417520')

SELECT interventions.nct_id, interventions.name, interventions.intervention_type
FROM interventions
WHERE interventions.nct_id IN ('NCT02089724','NCT02608619','NCT02298634','NCT03990428','NCT07454343','NCT02285582','NCT01417520')
AND interventions.name ILIKE '%pembro%'
